mission: Advance multiple independent non-P0 TRY FOREVER fronts while preserving existing owners and exact evidence states.

frontsAdvanced.changed: Rejected the tempting universal atomic scandir(fd) plan because Python exposes file-descriptor scandir on Unix rather than as a cross-platform contract; corrective replan narrowed the claim.
Added cross-platform no-follow root identity capture/revalidation source with symlink/junction classification and fail-closed identity semantics.
Added fixtures for same identity, persistent changed identity, symlink, Windows junction tag, zero/device-only identity, and redirector takeover.
Found and fixed a false identity rule where st_dev alone could count as stable object identity; final policy requires a non-zero inode/file-index component.
Narrowed persistent-replacement wording to observed identity/type drift and preserved swap-and-restore plus identity-token-reuse boundaries.
Added heartbeat-skill-root-identity-revalidation with owner, platform, evidence, and P0 boundaries.

Added touchable DOM/inline-SVG stable/redirector/changed/atomicity-open source specimen with radiogroup semantics, roving keyboard navigation, >=48px controls, non-color state tokens, live detail, and reduced-motion behavior.
Published an exact base-blob-locked integration patch for the existing provenance probe, explicitly STATUS PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED.
Published pre-mutation plan, corrective replan, Regnet review, Venice completion review, and fresh CI boundary without laundering source into TESTED/runtime capability.
